title: Internal Complaints Committee | KPGU
content: within a period of three months from the date of the last incident. You have to mention all your details like name, designation, mobile no & mail Id, enrolment no in case of student. Mention the incident description like date, time, location, respondent s name, working relationships etc. Committee shall follow the KPGU policy on prevention of sexual harassment.
